## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes.

## Validation

List commands and observed results. For UI changes, include keyboard checks and a screenshot using non-sensitive example data. State whether testing used mocked APIs, an unpacked extension with the companion, or a store-installed build.

## Compatibility and release notes

Describe changes to permissions, data handling, installed/embedded assets or documentation. Identify remaining release steps or known limitations.
